description: Portrait of O'Keeffe in a black suit and white blouse sitting in profile in  her studio on a bench covered with a crotched blanket; her hand leans on a large work table with plants, a light box and a large white cast bronze of "Abstraction"; across the table Juan leans back in his chair with his hands bent behind his head. Behind him are shelves with binders and boxes, papers and books and a typewriter on a desk.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe and Juan Hamilton in Abiquiu Studio, New Mexico
